tools.name: search_ai_agents
tools.description: Search AITeamGuide's fully listed AI agents and AI receptionist products (public prices checked by AITeamGuide). Filter by free text, job category, free plan, or a maximum lowest listed monthly price in USD. Returns name, vendor, category, starting price, free plan flag, checked date and the AITeamG

tools.name: get_agent_pricing
tools.description: Full pricing tiers for one AI agent or product listed on AITeamGuide, by id (e.g. 'cursor') or name, with the vendor pricing source and the date the price was checked.

tools.name: cheapest_ai_agents
tools.description: AI agents in one category sorted by lowest listed monthly price (USD), cheapest first. Products with no listed monthly price are left out.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Category slugs used by AITeamGuide with the number of fully listed products in each.
